en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old electric tram at a street stop in a village or small town. The tram is marked with route number 15 and destination "Südstadt." Several people, including a conductor and passengers, stand near the tram on a narrow street with trees, houses, and a church spire visible in the background. At the bottom is a German caption identifying the place and tram stop.
